call_anthropic_response: call the /v1/messages endpoint to send a request to 100+ LLMs in Anthropic API format
count_tokens_anthropic: count tokens for an Anthropic Messages API request with model name and messages
send_event_logging_batch: send a batch of event logging requests to the stubbed /api/event_logging/batch endpoint
build_anthropic_router: build a FastAPI router that groups Anthropic-compatible proxy endpoints under /v1/messages
process_llm_request: process an LLM request through ProxyBaseLLMRequestProcessing with model, user, and routing configuration
